en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 5. And from the previous chain from Abdillah b. Hamad from Abdillah b. Bakr from Hamran b. A’yan from Abi Ja’far (a.s.) who said: “

Even if all angels created by Almighty Allah, all prophets, truthful ones and martyrs try to intercede for an enemy of Ahle Bayt (a.s.) so that Allah, the Mighty and Sublime takes him out of Hell, Allah will never take him out of Hell.
And Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, says in the Holy Quran, “Staying in it (Hell) for ever.”22
